description: Whether a Sharpe survives the number of variants tried: probabilistic and deflated Sharpe (0 to 1) and the Sharpe luck alone would reach. Send the seven statistics or a return series, not both. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

cross_trial_sharpe_sd_annualized.description: Standard deviation of the annualized Sharpe across those trials.

effective_independent_trials.description: Independent variants tried before choosing this one.

non_excess_kurtosis.description: Kurtosis, not excess kurtosis; 3 if Normal.

periods_per_year.description: Observations per year: 252 daily, 365 daily crypto, 52 weekly, 12 monthly.

returns.description: Periodic returns as fractions (0.01 is 1%), oldest first; replaces the Sharpe, observations, skew and kurtosis fields.

skew.description: Skewness of the returns; below -0.5 the reading warns that the counts are too generous.
